Chapter 1237: Chapter 1: Tremendous Merit (Subscribe Please)_2

It’s not baseless talk that quantity changes can cause qualitative changes.

"This primordial being, even if their power is not as great as mine, would definitely surpass the so-called Strongest Venerable. How did they die?"

Lin Yuan felt quite curious in his heart; particles contain worlds, equivalent to each particle being an individual entity capable of easily forming avatars and even clones.

Such a powerful being, even if all the Strongest Venerables from the Origin Source World besieged them, it would be impossible for them to die.

But the origin of Dragon Abyss Valley clearly identifies it as the place where this being fell.

Only when the True Spirit completely dissipates can such a treasure land, capable of continuously nurturing Dragon Abyss Blood, be created.

"Da Fu Ancestor..."

Lin Yuan easily speculated that it was related to the Ancestor.

Only a thirteenth stage Ancestor could easily slay such existences.

"It seems that Da Fu Ancestor had great enmity with this primordial being..." Lin Yuan thought secretly.

Da Fu Ancestor not only completely killed this primordial being but also gathered its True Spirit and bloodline to form the treasure land known as Dragon Frost Marquise.

This allowed the countless creatures nurtured by Dragon Blood Valley to be kept and then stripped and purified of their bloodline by the powerhouses of Da Fu Ancient Country for generations.

The creatures nurtured by Dragon Frost Marquise are, in a strict sense, the descendants of that primordial being.

...

"First, let’s try absorbing and refining it."

Lin Yuan stopped overthinking and immediately began refining this drop of Dragon Abyss Blood.

Most of his mind was immersed in comprehending the operation of the Origin Source World, leaving only a small part to refine the Dragon Abyss Blood, which wouldn’t hinder anything.

...

Chaos Void.

The Chaos Qi drifted, and two figures appeared silently, quietly watching the distant void.

These two figures gathered their auras, but vaguely, the grand path rules operating in the Chaos Void began to recede, revealing that they were two Peerless Great Saints.

"This should be the last place where Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix appeared." The Peerless Great Saint on the left was a bald figure, looking around solemnly at this moment.

"Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix, although they are newly promoted Great Saints, have mysteriously had their karmic ties completely disappear, which is quite strange." The Peerless Great Saint on the right said with a frown.

The complete disappearance of karmic ties implies only two possibilities.

One is reincarnation, abandoning everything to start anew.

The other is complete demise, with all life-preserving measures of the true body, duplicates, and avatars being extinguished.

The two Peerless Great Saints knew of the enmity between Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint. If Shadow Demon Great Saint voluntarily reincarnated and completely cut off karmic ties to avoid Nine Phoenix Great Saint, it wouldn’t be surprising.

But both new Great Saints’ karmic ties disappearing simultaneously? That’s very odd.

Could it be that both new Great Saints have reincarnated?

If not, then they must have completely perished.

That would be even more unbelievable.

Could two Chaos Great Saints have fallen completely at the same time?

At least a Peerless Great Saint couldn’t achieve that.

"Luo Hou Great Saint has instructed us to investigate; indeed, there’s a need for this." The bald figure on the right said.

The two new Chaos Great Saints do not draw much attention from them.

However, their complete disappearance is enough to raise alarms.

"Luo Hou Great Saint is about to reign in the Chaos Void, affirming the title of ’Invincible’, so whatever he instructs is certainly not just talk." The Peerless Great Saint on the left nodded.

Luo Hou Great Saint is an extremely ancient Great Saint who focused on cultivating a thirteenth stage inheritance, and upon mastering it, he’ll sweep the Chaos Void of many Peerless Great Saints.

The two Peerless Great Saints, by happenchance, approached Luo Hou Great Saint’s secluded dwelling and briefly exchanged hands, recognizing each other’s terrifying strength, and thereby choosing to follow and serve him.

"I’ll first try reversing time to see." The bald figure’s eyes faintly showed time flowing backward.

Very quickly.

The bald figure stopped, frowned, and said, "Time and space are completely chaotic, nothing can be discerned."

Reversing time refers to reconstructing images and scenes from past times, but such image scenes can be interfered with.

"Same here." The Peerless Great Saint on the left nodded and also attempted to reverse time, but similarly found nothing.

"What should we do now?"

The Peerless Great Saint on the left looked towards the bald figure.

"Luo Hou Great Saint’s charge must be completed." The bald figure pondered for a while and said, "We should start investigating from the karmic ties of Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix themselves, who their enemies are..."

"That’s the only way." The Peerless Great Saint on the left sighed.

This method, although effective, is extremely tedious.

The Chaos Great Saints have traversed many Void Domains, creating countless karmic ties.

Investigating one by one is too cumbersome.

Whether it can ultimately be figured out remains an unknown.

But for now, this is the only way to follow the clues.

Even if nothing is found in the end, at least they can report back to Luo Hou Great Saint.

...

Origin Source World, the capital of Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

In the Galaxy Royal Mansion, Lin Yuan and Red Flame Venerable sat facing each other.

"Galaxy, based on the time, we should be able to determine the merits today." Red Flame Venerable smiled at Lin Yuan and said, "With Galaxy’s performance in the battlefield acquisition, the merits you earn will certainly be astonishing."

"The emperor gave me the treasure land; will that affect the merit judgment?" Lin Yuan looked at Red Flame Venerable.

"That’s two separate matters." Red Flame Venerable said, "The final result is that our Fierce Sun Ancient Country acquired the treasure land. As for to whom it belongs, it’s not within the scope of merit judgment."

Lin Yuan nodded.

As a top-tier Peak Venerable of Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Red Flame Venerable had experienced numerous full-scale wars between ancient countries and was very experienced in merit judgment.

"Besides, with the strength of Galaxy Venerate, gaining merits is too easy." Red Flame Venerable laughed.

For an ordinary Great Lord, acquiring merits is a difficult task, only to be accumulated through countless local wars.

Venerables fare better, able to guard treasure lands and have stable channels for gaining merits, but accumulating the rare merit needed for their inheritance would also consume a lot of years.

But for Lin Yuan?

If Lin Yuan desired, gaining merits was not hard; merely strolling to the border between Fierce Sun Ancient Country and the other five ancient countries for a deterrent display would yield copious merits.

If a war erupted and Lin Yuan intervened to end it, the merits gained would be tremendous.

Of course, the other ancient countries aren’t fools; knowing the Invincible Venerable like Lin Yuan exists, they wouldn’t initiate conflicts, and would rather prioritize concessions.

"How much merit is usually rewarded for such a contest over a newly emerged treasure land?" Lin Yuan asked.

"I’m not certain either." Red Flame Venerable thought for a moment, "This treasure land isn’t an ordinary first-class treasure land but a top-tier first-class treasure land. The specifics depend on the elders’ decisions."

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Though the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is ruled by an emperor, major decisions are made collectively by the elders.

"The merits have been finalized."

At this moment, Red Flame Venerable’s expression changed slightly as he received a message from the ancient country.

"The merits I got are 2,320,000..." Red Flame Venerable immediately said, looking slightly satisfied.

2,320,000 merits, compared to seizing a top-tier first-class treasure land, is not high, but to be fair, Red Flame Venerable didn’t exert much effort in the process of acquiring this treasure land.

The most brutal phase of the treasure land contest—the final battle—hardly occurred; it was all Lin Yuan alone who broke through against several ancient countries.

In such circumstances, earning more than two million merits made Red Flame Venerable very content.

Equivalent to two thousand years, they earned 2,320,000 merits.

This merit acquisition ratio over time is remarkably high.

To know, the merits gained from guarding a first-class treasure land averaging over two thousand years are just single-digit merits.

"Heng Yan Guanglie and the others also earned between one and two million merits each." Red Flame Venerable said, as the merit judgments came down, other Venerables involved in the contest also informed him of the merits they received.

Lin Yuan sat there and also received a message from the ancient country.

"3,600,000,000,000 merits?" Lin Yuan glanced at his merit ’balance’ change, taken aback.
